name: Agoda

Senior Software Engineer.dsaDepth: Moderate — an OA/coding round then a design-heavy in-person stage, with real variance in stack (backend vs frontend/JavaScript) between what candidates expect and what gets asked
rounds: Online coding round (HackerRank): 2-3 easy-medium algorithm problems (examples reported: counting planes shot down, pivot element in an unsorted array, minimum-sum pairs)

In-person/virtual rounds (3-4): system design, past-project discussion, sometimes a stack mismatch — candidates report being pulled into frontend/JavaScript topics despite expecting a backend-focused conversation
extraTopics: Clarifying the expected stack/scope early — a recurring make-or-break factor, more so than raw question difficulty
Staying flexible through a notably long process (often 2+ months with long gaps between rounds)

Principal Software Engineer.dsaDepth: Heavy — coding, LLD, HLD and a system round, with the whole process reported as unusually lengthy (up to 8-9 rounds) and inconsistent
rounds: Code review round for some pipelines
extraTopics: Persisting through a long, sometimes disorganized process — multiple candidates report being rejected late (after many positive rounds) for reasons like years-of-experience mismatch rather than skill
Principal Software Engineer.notes: Selection is explicitly described by one candidate as "completely dependent upon the hiring manager" — consistency across interviewers/teams appears low.
